findingsIncorporated: Finding 1 (moderate): CP1 mischaracterized S2's SQL gate as 'untouched, unaccounted-only' -- actually UPDATE_ENVELOPE_CELLS_SQL carries two OR-widened remediation terms from OPS-21-R1, and gateFieldWrite/gateFootprintWrite's remediation-revisit branch only admits a value/refused target, not not-applicable. The invariant (this population is always currently 'unaccounted', so only the isFirstWrite fast path is ever exercised) holds, live-confirmed, but was previously asserted rather than documented as a reliance. FIXED: both new module-doc blocks (S1 and S2) now state this explicitly, and notApplicableFromUpstreamCells's own doc comment in S2 names the reliance directly.

Finding 2 (moderate): S1 counts notApplicable per-PARCEL (all-rails-together write model); S2 counts it per-CELL (up to 3x per parcel, matching S2's existing value/refused/absentVerified counting convention). CP1's verification plan did not flag this asymmetry. FIXED: this checkpoint's pilot results below report both counting conventions explicitly and reconcile them (132 = 44 x 3), rather than treating a mismatch as an error.

Finding 3 (minor): pushIfPresent's kind-switch needed an explicit 'not-applicable' branch ahead of the absent-verified catch-all, or every not-applicable cell would have silently miscounted as absentVerified (write itself unaffected, only the self-reported total). FIXED in implementation: parcel-envelope-cells.mjs's pushIfPresent now has `else if (state.kind === "not-applicable") counts.notApplicable += 1;` before the catch-all.

Finding 4 (low/advisory): notApplicable needed manual addition to counts-init/totals-init/console.error in both files (not derived from a constant). Done in all six locations; verified via the live pilot run below that the totals aggregation and console.error line both report the real number, not a silent zero.
